note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damaged utilities and a sagging ceiling are stop-work hazards. Entry waits for qualified personnel.
Damaged electrical equipment is not operated, and a labelled breaker or gloves do not change that.

practicalCriteria: The learner identifies damaged wiring, gas lines, overhead loads, weakened stairs and unstable walls as stop-work hazards.
The learner refuses to operate damaged equipment and does not propose do-it-yourself electrical or structural work.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: Damaged electrical or gas equipment is visible or suspected.
A structural element is visibly unstable and no qualified assessment has been recorded.
